description: R2R is a series of datasets listed in Brazilian national spatial data infrastructure metadata catalogue (INDE), a metadata catalogue (CSW), published or maintained by Infraestrutura Nacional de Dados Espaciais (INDE). A classe Ponte faz parte da categoria Sistema de Transportes da Base Cartográfica Vetorial Contínua do Estado do Rio de Janeiro, na escala 1:25.000, desenvolvida no âmbito do Projeto RJ25, foi elaborada a partir de uma parceria entre o IBGE e o Governo do Estado do Rio de Janeiro, através da Secretaria de Estado do ... Coverage: Brasil. The portal lists 45 near-identical datasets in this series (one per year, month, area or site), grouped in this record; the first few are linked. Its tags are R2R, environment. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-csw-inde-portal.
